name: Retail People Counting
description: People flow analytics for retail: tracks persons, classifies dwell states (browsing / engaged / assistance), counts entries and exits, and publishes rolling zone metrics over MQTT. Streams H.264 via RTSP.
description_zh: 面向零售场景的人流分析：跟踪人员、区分停留状态（浏览 / 驻足 / 求助），统计进店与离店，并通过 MQTT 发布滚动区域指标。以 RTSP 推送 H.264 视频。
author: Seeed Studio
